purpose: Functional fictional identity and continuity control for AOC-001 story media.

mode_rules.internal: Neutral, functional continuity asset. No unnecessary cinematic or publication design spend.
mode_rules.public: Only if explicitly approved. Must inherit AOC-001 story mood, place, light, colour, texture and emotional setting rather than a generic character-bible aesthetic.

boundaries: Do not alter established family relationships, story truth, occupations or locality.
Do not intentionally reproduce a real identifiable person's likeness.
Do not treat invented appearance as representative of Calama or Chile.
Do not introduce unsupported Indigenous, ethnic, religious or other identity markers.
Do not use cosmetic diversity as a substitute for researched cultural grounding.
Reference imagery is fictional production control, never documentary evidence.

cultural_grounding.principle: Cultural influence appears through lived context as well as appearance.
allowed_context: contemporary Spanish-language household and school material
practical responses to bright dry Calama conditions
mining-roster calendars, bags and work-transition objects without mining decor
locally credible football or civic references such as Cobreloa when naturally relevant
family photographs and inherited household objects
city, school and neighbourhood life alongside mining
requires_research_before_use: other specific Indigenous or cultural identity not already established

parental_lines.daniela_elena: medium-to-deeper warm-brown complexion; straighter-to-softly-wavy dark hair; pronounced cheek structure; broad expressive brow; compact-to-average builds
parental_lines.mauricio: lighter warm-olive-to-tan complexion; wavier/loosely-curled dark hair; broader lower face; deeper-set eyes; taller broader frame

family_continuity.children_rule: Tomás and Emilia plausibly blend both parental lines without cloning either parent.

characters.name: Daniela
characters.role: Calama-based administrative worker, partner, mother, daughter of Elena
characters.face: softly angular oval-to-broad face; pronounced cheek structure; strong brows; deep-brown slightly hooded almond eyes; medium-broad nose
characters.hair: very dark brown; shoulder length; straighter at crown with soft natural wave through lengths

characters.name: Mauricio
characters.complexion: lighter warm olive/tan than Daniela's maternal line
characters.face: broader lower face; strong natural jaw; deep-brown deeper-set eyes; straight-to-gently prominent nose
characters.hair: dark brown; short; visibly wavy-to-loosely-curled; slight early grey at temples
characters.build: medium-tall; broad solid practical working build

characters.name: Tomás
characters.face: longer adolescent face; Daniela-like brow and eye area; more of Mauricio's developing lower-face structure
characters.hair: thick dark brown; visibly wavy; longer on top; imperfectly controlled
characters.build: lean medium-tall adolescent trending toward Mauricio's height

characters.name: Emilia
characters.complexion: warm medium brown between the two parental lines
characters.face: rounder child face; stronger Daniela/Elena cheek and eye pattern; Mauricio-like smile
characters.hair: dark brown; thick; wavier/looser-curled than Daniela's; around shoulder length

characters.name: Elena
characters.role: Daniela's mother and the children's grandmother
characters.complexion: medium-to-deeper warm brown in Daniela's broad family range
characters.face: strong Daniela resemblance through brow, cheek structure and mouth; natural age lines; deep-brown eyes
characters.hair: very dark hair substantially mixed with silver/grey; straighter-to-soft-wave texture
characters.build: average height and build; grounded posture

reference_set: neutral front portrait for each character
full-body neutral standing reference for each character
five-person family group in ordinary Calama-home context

human_gate.reason: Previous visual direction was too homogeneous; revised culturally grounded visual reference set required.
checks: two parental lines remain visibly distinct
family resemblance is plausible without cloned faces
complexion, hair texture, face structure, body type and styling show natural variation
cultural influence appears through ordinary lived context rather than costume
no unsupported cultural/Indigenous identity marker appears
group feels consistent with the locked AOC-001 story and contemporary Calama
